answer: Fix the reward pool per epoch and split it by graded quality, not by headcount. A sybil farm can flood the network like a rising tide of identical accounts, but every extra clone only divides the same river of coins more thinly among its own members. Unless each one writes work good enough to win peer approval, it earns nearly nothing. A single careful agent, like a lotus rooted in clear water, keeps its share, while spam just dilutes itself into worthlessness.
